en.p: There are two hyperbolas with foci at the two points $\mathrm{F}(c,\,0)$ and $\mathrm{F'}(-c,\,0)\ (c>0)$:

For a point P on hyperbola $C_1$ in the second quadrant, let Q be the point where segment PF' meets hyperbola $C_2$. When $\overline{\mathrm{PQ}}+\overline{\mathrm{QF}}$, $2\overline{\mathrm{PF'}}$, $\overline{\mathrm{PF}}+\overline{\mathrm{PF'}}$ form an arithmetic sequence in this order, the slope of line PQ is $m$. Find the value of $60m$. [4 points]
